name: Erimo (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Erimo town emblem in white: a stylised swirl with a pointed wing.
history: Municipal flag of Erimo, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 January 1959; the emblem dates from 14 July 1970.

features.role: Erimo town emblem — a stylised swirl with a pointed wing
